svg.title: Selected work
svg.desc: 01 Concreat Rewards (applications): A rewards portal where partners earn points per bag, share them and redeem rewards. Approved Rewards proposal; 10% sales 5 yrs at +5 pts retention. 03 SpoonFull (data & reporting): Scans each tray to measure what residents ate, then recommends diet adjustments. ~$23K/yr Net operating savings; 15m → 10s Per intake record time reduction. 07 Lead Follow-up Reminder (automation): Reads the lead tracker and emails one weekly list of follow-ups, owners and actions. 93% Weekly review time reduction; ~$2.1K/yr Estimated savings, +$34/yr per lead. 08 HubSpot CRM Cleanup (data & reporting): Traces duplicate contacts, tags lead sources, fills missing addresses and reports daily. 324 → 22 Leads needing manual review; 395 Duplicates caught before import.
